text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Friday. Reuters has not verified them nor does it vouch for their accuracy.

- The campaign for nation-wide local elections is over and the "electoral silence" ahead of Sunday's poll began at midnight. All meetings and press conferences have finished, and any interruption to the 48-hour period of silence will be punished through the courts.

- The 5th anniversary of adopting the new constitution of independent Macedonia was celebrated. The president of the parliament Tito Petkovski said "this document represents the foundation of the new political, economic and deomocratic system of the country".
- The independent Syndicate of Doctors and Pharmacists threaten to go on strike demanding better conditions for private medical practices.

- The Macedonian police have siezed 3.1 kilogrammes of heroin in one car close to Bitola. The official statement said "all indications point to an organised group who transported and dealt with drugs in the country".
